paragraphs: "Those who study before the Sages" (lamdin lifnei ḥakhamim).
This is Levi [studying] from Rabbi, [Sanhedrin 17b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.17b.4); see his entry.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The heading is a formula used to introduce a teaching. Here the student is Levi and the teacher is Rabbi.
The linked passage identifies “those who study before the Sages” as Levi studying under Rabbi. It then gives a separate formula for “those who judge before the Sages.”
